about: Buildings around the modelled core that are not in data/measurements.json: outlines measured on the oblique zoom-19 satellite mosaic, converted to ground positions. Used by src/world/extras/context.js, which carries a copy of "buildings" between its <context-data> markers.
method: Each roof outline was read once off gridded enlargements (2x to 4x) of the mosaic. A roof pixel at height h was moved by (+0.243 h, -2.0 h) px before conversion (same lean as scripts/build-campus-data.mjs). Heights: from the 2018 or 2022 video where a frame shows the building, from the length of north-facade features on the mosaic where readable (2.0 px per metre), otherwise ASSUMED by building type - see heightBasis of each entry. positionAccuracyM combines the reading error (about 3 px) with the effect of the height uncertainty.
caveats: Single readings: none of these outlines has been re-read independently.
Whether a building belongs to the school is not known unless stated; no name or function is given to any of them.
Skewed outlines were squared where noted. Wall colours of faces in shade and all faces not shown by a video frame are assumed.

groundApron.what: Plain paving drawn by the module under the south group beyond the landscape survey window
groundApron.basis: The mosaic shows paved yards, lanes and parking round these buildings; the extent and the single surface are schematic, not measured.

buildings.confidence: seen in the 2022 video (frames_yibenshu f_060, from the east) and in satellite
buildings.measuredBy: single reading on the zoom-19 mosaic (0.2747 m per pixel), not re-read
buildings.heightBasis: Frame f_060: its roof lies in line with the roof of the south teaching slab (20.7 m) and a little below the roof of the glass stair block (24 m). Five teaching storeys of 3.9 m plus parapet ASSUMED; no facade band is readable on the mosaic (the canopy hides the north face).
buildings.notes: Long narrow block along the south edge of the plaza canopy, west of the clock tower. Roof px x 1240-1393, y 1306-1362: flat part with white lines (1306-1330), a dark line (1330-1340) and a band with a repeating slatted pattern (1340-1362). In frame f_060 the slatted, pergola-like panels lie on the SOUTH strip of the roof; the part north of them is hidden behind the clock tower. The frame also shows tall white fins at the south-east corner and dark green glazing on the east end. The east end as read (x 190.8 m) reaches the west face of the clock tower, whose leaning image hides anything further east; the builder trims the block 0.3 m short of the clock tower and of the glass stair block and 0.5 m short of the canopy edge, using their current positions. The builder draws the ground storey open on columns between two solid end cores: that is an assumption (no reference shows the ground storey) which keeps the plaza reachable from the south. Everything else about the faces is assumed.

Bearing check: in f_064 (camera over the east straight, about z -16) it lies 8.5 degrees west of south, i.e. x about 26 m at z 108; the ring moved back by the lean gives x 28.9. Drum radius, number of columns (12) and their radius are ASSUMED from the proportions in f_064.

buildings.notes: Courtyard building south of the inferred road south of the courts. Roofs: north bar px (905-1170, 1903-1942) covered with small rooftop units, west bar (905-940, 1942-2012), south-west bar (935-1040, 2008-2042, slightly skewed in the image, squared here), south-east bar (1045-1168, 1985-2028), a link (1035-1050, 1940-2010), an east end (1150-1172, 1942-1990) and a round tower, centre (912,2030), radius 18 px, at the south-west corner. Video: long face with a white frame and red-brown infill panels with balconies, a white end wall with a blue-green glazed stair strip, a thin roof slab; beside it a rounded white building with blue ribbon windows. In f_066 the rounded building lies 6.7 degrees left of the pavilion, which is where the round tower should appear from a camera near (-21,-40); the long face fits the north bar less well (about 5 degrees off), so the match is probable, not proven. Faces not seen in the video are assumed.

buildings.notes: Three east-west bars joined by a spine on the east, with two courtyards. Roofs: bar 1 px (895-1170, 2125-2190), bar 2 (925-1175, 2290-2345, slightly skewed in the image, squared here), bar 3 (1030-1185, 2400-2445), spine (1160-1200, 2130-2440); bars 2 and 3 carry framed dark panels (roof openings or pergolas, not modelled). A lower flat roof with a white rim and a rounded north-west corner, px (808-890, 2130-2215), stands at the north-west; its height (8 m) is a guess. Wall colours are NOT readable (north faces in shade): cream is assumed. A red-surfaced lane runs along the south-west side.

buildings.measuredBy: single reading on the zoom-19 mosaic (0.2747 m per pixel), not re-read
buildings.heightBasis: Mosaic: on the north face vertical pilaster lines about 150 px long that follow the lean direction exactly (dx/dy -0.11), and a sunlit east face with 20 or more balcony dashes; 150 px / 2.0 px per metre = 75 m, 25 floors of 3.0 m. A reading error of 10 px is 5 m of height and 1.4 m of position.
buildings.notes: High-rise with roofs at px (1228-1425, 2298-2445) around a light well, plus a lower-looking pale roof on the west (1200-1260, 2385-2455) that is drawn at the same height because its own height could not be read. East face reddish brown in sunlight with white balcony slabs; roof pale with many small units. The spine roof of the E-shaped complex west of it lies in shadow over about 30 m, which also asks for a tall object here. Alternative reading, not adopted: a low hall with a dark ribbed roof north of a separate 7-storey block. A curved drive or ramp (arc about px (1265,2090), radius 60) lies north-west of it; not modelled. Use, owner and whether it stands inside the campus are unknown.
